shared_elements: head of a creature (bird- or animal-headed) in relief/sculpture
rows of parallel incised lines forming banded texture (hair, mane or feathering)
curved beak-like or snout-like projecting muzzle
justification: The only real correspondence is that both show a creature's head whose hair/mane/feathering is rendered as ordered rows of parallel incised bands ending in curls, a fairly generic convention for schematising fur or plumage. A depicts a complete standing winged anthropomorphic figure with raised arm, bucket and richly patterned garment within a framed panel, whereas B shows only an isolated blocky head in the round with no accompanying body, attributes or scene, so no relationships or arrangement can be matched.
